$schema_note: Structured per the kicad-happy datasheets skill Pin/AltFunction shape (schemas/pinout.schema.json), extended with af_code lookups and a power section for schematic/PCB review use.

datasheet.title: STM32U545xx - Ultra-low-power Arm Cortex-M33 MCU with TrustZone, 512-Kbyte Flash, 274-Kbyte SRAM, USB

package.name: UFQFPN48
package.description: 48-pin, 7x7 mm, 0.5 mm pitch QFN with exposed thermal pad (matches KiCad footprint QFN-48-1EP_7x7mm_P0.5mm_EP5.6x5.6mm)
package.notes: Non-SMPS ordering variant selected (user requirement: NO SMPS). Package shares identical pin numbering 1-48 with LQFP48 per datasheet Table 27 (same column). No dedicated VDDUSB or VDDIO2 pin is broken out on this 48-pin package; USB (_u) and VDDIO2-only (_s) I/O structure suffixes are architecturally defined but the relevant supply pins are not physically exposed here - verify against reference manual before assuming behavior identical to 100-pin variants.

exposed_pad.recommended_connection: VSS (ground) - see package mechanical/thermal section of datasheet for thermal via recommendations

part_number_decode.example_pattern: STM32 U 545 C E U 6 Q TR
part_number_decode.device_subfamily: 545 = STM32U545xx with USB and hardware AES/PKA crypto accelerator

io_structure_legend.RST: Bidirectional reset pin with embedded weak pull-up resistor
io_structure_legend._a: I/O with analog switch function supplied by VDDA
io_structure_legend._t: I/O with tamper function supplied by VSW
io_structure_legend._u: I/O with USB function supplied by VDDUSB

pin_notes_legend.(1): Function availability depends on the chosen device.
pin_notes_legend.(2): PC13/PC14/PC15 are supplied through the power switch (VSW). The switch sinks a limited current (3 mA): PC13 speed must not exceed 2 MHz with max load 30 pF; refer to FT_o electrical characteristics for PC14/PC15; these GPIOs must not be used as current sources (e.g. to drive an LED).
pin_notes_legend.(3): After a backup-domain power-up, PC13/PC14/PC15 operate as GPIOs. Their function then depends on RTC register content, which is not reset by a system reset. See backup domain / RTC register description in the reference manual.
pin_notes_legend.(4): After reset, this pin is configured as a JTAG/SWD alternate function. Internal pull-up on PA15/PA13/PB4 and internal pull-down on PA14 are activated by default.

VDD.description: Standard digital supply (also powers most GPIOs on this package)
VDD.note: Max drops to 2.7 V if IO_VDD_HSLV (high-speed low-voltage) option is enabled.

VDDA.note: Decouple per datasheet figure: 100 nF + 1 uF close to VDDA, plus 100 nF + 1 uF on VREF+/VREF-.

VBAT.description: Backup domain supply (RTC, LSE, TAMP, backup registers) when VDD absent

VCAP.description: Internal core voltage regulator (LDO) output - requires external decoupling capacitor, do not use as a supply source

power_rails.VIN_absolute_max_note: Standard I/O: -0.3V to Min(min(VDD,VDDA,VDDUSB,VDDIO2)+3.6V, 5.5V). Always respect VIN max regardless of formula result; see Table 31 for max injected current.

boot_strap_pins.PH3-BOOT0: Physical BOOT0 pin, sampled at reset to select boot mode (system memory vs main flash, per Table 6/Table 7 boot mode tables). Confirm firmware/OB configuration matches the schematic pull resistor.
boot_strap_pins.PA13_PA14_PA15_PB4_JTAG_SWD: After reset these pins default to JTAG/SWD alternate function with internal pull-up (PA13/PA15/PB4) or pull-down (PA14) already active - factor this into any external pull network sizing (see pin_notes_legend (4)).

notes.text: PC13/PC14/PC15 are supplied through the power switch (VSW). The switch sinks a limited current (3 mA): PC13 speed must not exceed 2 MHz with max load 30 pF; refer to FT_o electrical characteristics for PC14/PC15; these GPIOs must not be used as current sources (e.g. to drive an LED).
